column1: # il_op: the operator of an IL tree node (il_node.op), named as the stage's tree dump names them (the lowercase
# name table at 00434668, printed by the tree dump at 004086b0; the uppercase copy at 00433270 serves the block
# dump). Values without a name in the table are IL_NON_xx: every value needs a member, or the decompiler spells an
# unnamed one as an expression of others.
